pinout.drain: pins 5,6,7,8 + exposed pad (on variants with pad)
pinout.notes: Classic SO-8 footprint — pin 4 gate, pins 1/2/3 source, pins 5/6/7/8 drain.

typical_applications: Charger input MOSFET (with proper VDS margin)
verification_notes: Electrical ratings verified against Vishay datasheet. NOTE: this is NOT a logic-level FET — RDS_on specified at VGS=10V. Driving from a 5V or lower gate will not fully enhance the FET.
replacement_notes: Not logic-level. Replacement candidates must match the gate-drive voltage of the controller: a 5V-driven replacement MUST be logic-level (RDS_on specified at VGS=4.5V).
